request.title: The prisoner is Fiddle Blackthorne
request.prompt: Painterly dark-fantasy illustration in the style of a cinematic tabletop RPG book spread: wide 16:9 landscape composition, dramatic lighting with warm ember-orange highlights against cold ice-blue shadows, rich texture, a clear focal point. No text, no captions, no speech bubbles, no logos, no watermark. Scene: a cold stone prison cell glazed with ice. A caged goblin, Fiddle, grins knowingly through the bars while a rough human fighter in a plain tunic, sickle at his belt, sweats nervously beside the party. A sly reveal. Characters: Fiddle: a small green-skinned goblin ranger with large pointed ears, leather armour hung with clover charms and dice.
